row: full_model_chain follow-up: reference scoring of xrt_tokens.json + single-GPU profiling
commands: # all from the worktree root; WT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); CK=~/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B; R=<runs dir>; one leased GPU per command (pool 3,7 in wave B)

notes.provenance: measured_commits is derived from each run file's own commit field (captured when the run starts; dirty = tracked files modified at that moment). Wave B: every run was re-measured. The triton runs, the HF runs and the profiles ran at 39053b2 (clean); the golden runs ran from `git archive 615ee61` (a clean copy of the commit, so the run's own git lookup found no repository and its commit field was filled in afterwards from the archive; see xrt_reference_golden.json commit_note). Strict code (strict_model, chain_harness, golden_ops, paged_kv, weights, backend, every ops/ and triton/ file) is identical from 39053b2 to the final commit of this row; later commits only add scripts, reports and data.
notes.o7_fix: c88607f (softcap kernels launched with enable_fp_fusion=False) changed strict Triton logprob bits; every triton measurement here includes it (includes_o7_fix). The previous triton xrt file (f7d3723) agreed with the regenerated one on 739/933 tokens. The golden backend does not use the Triton O7 kernel.
notes.removed: chain_triton_512_hf_pre_change (307fcf2, the wave A before/after check of that row's own code change) and xrt_triton_repeat from the wave A first run (69b4409): both predate c88607f and are superseded by the wave B re-runs; the raw wave A files remain in the session scratchpad only.
notes.hf_anchor_attention: chain runs: HF eager attention (as in the original row report); xrt_reference_hf_bf16 and the HF profile: sdpa
notes.profile_views: wall = CUDA-event exclusive time per region (median of 3 prefill / 5 decode repeats, instrumented run; includes CPU launch gaps); gpu = torch.profiler kernel time charged to the innermost region open at launch (kernel_profile = the first of 3 profiler calls; kernel_profile_repeats = all 3); clean_total_ms = CUDA events around the whole call without regions
notes.host_load: the node was shared with other agents during the wave B runs: load average 335 / 404 / 296 (1 / 5 / 15 min, 240 cores) right after the profiles finished. Launch-bound numbers (decode wall times, T=512 wall times) depend on host load (strict decode B=1 clean 149 ms here vs 132 ms in wave A; HF decode B=1 260 ms vs 130 ms); the gpu view (kernel time) does not (repeat spread below 1 % for strict).
notes.decode_setup: strict: 16 sequences of 2048 random tokens prefilled through the paged cache, then batched decode steps (commit=True, context 2048..2060); HF: DynamicCache from one batched prefill of B x 2048 tokens, then decode steps with full-vocab logits + fp32 log_softmax
notes.prefill_setup: prefill_train = training forward over T tokens with the selected-token logp of every position (strict varlen attention; HF forward with use_cache=False, full logits, fp32 log_softmax + gather); prefill_paged (strict only) = one-shot paged prefill of T tokens with logp of every position; its KV cache is allocated per call outside the timed region and only one is alive at a time, so peak_allocated_gib includes exactly one call's cache (prepared_state_gib) on top of the train-forward activations
notes.xrt_decode_timing: xrt_scoring decode checks now time the prompt prefill and every decode step separately (prompt_prefill_seconds, decode_step_seconds, decode_step_context); per-token decode cost = decode_seconds_excl_prefill / decode_steps
notes.batched_decode_gate: tests/models/muse_glimmer/test_full_model_chain.py::test_batched_decode_is_batch_invariant_with_eviction (real weights, triton): 16 sequences with contexts 1..2100 (2100 > W+16 evicts pages), 3 decode steps, batch 1 == 2 == permuted 4 == reversed 16 == committed 16 per sequence (fp32 bit patterns), and two sequences' committed decode logps == the training forward; the profile's decode_batch_invariance is the same property at context 2048 measured once

wave_b_review.tests_before_tree: f91e8b6 (the new test files copied into `git archive f91e8b6`)

verdicts.change: KVPlan.validate(): unique ids, 0 <= id < cache.max_seqs, equal seqs/starts/lens lengths, lens >= 1, starts == committed lengths; decode_batch validates the ids before reading lengths; every paged forward validates its plan (and that positions are the plan's positions) before any K/V write
verdicts.before: duplicate ids [0,0]: no error, row 0 differs from the batch-1 step (|dlogp| 0.0179 on the tiny model; 0.23 on real weights per the review); test FAILED (DID NOT RAISE); negative ids not probed on old builds (device-side assert)
verdicts.after: ValueError before any write; cache K/V, block table and lengths unchanged; PASSED

verdicts.change: measure(prepare=, release=): the paged-prefill KV cache is allocated per call outside the timed region and only one is alive at a time; mem_allocated_before_gib holds no per-call state; prepared_state_gib records the one cache included in the peak
verdicts.evidence: profile_strict at 39053b2: prefill_paged mem_allocated_before_gib 52.10 (= prefill_train); peak 52.25 / 52.67 / 53.23 vs train 52.22 / 52.57 / 53.03 GiB at T = 512 / 2048 / 4096; prepared_state_gib 0.026 / 0.102 / 0.204 (one cache). Wave A: before 52.16 / 52.69 / 53.41, peak 52.28 / 53.16 / 54.33

verdicts.change: collect_results.profile_record replaces kernel_profile.by_group_gpu_ms with the regrouped values and records the GROUPS list (one grouping in the file); the profiles were also re-measured at 39053b2 so the nested field was computed with the current groups anyway

tests/models/muse_glimmer/test_full_model_chain.py::test_batched_decode_is_batch_invariant_with_eviction (real weights, triton): 16 sequences with contexts 1..2100 in one paged cache (2100 > W+16, so local layers evict pages; asserted), 3 decode steps; per step batch 1 == batch 2 == permuted batch 4 == reversed batch 16 == committed batch 16 (fp32 bit patterns), and the committed decode logps of sequences 0 (2100, evicting) and 6 (17) equal logprobs(mode='train')
verdicts.evidence: MUSEGLIMMER_CHECKPOINT=... MUSEGLIMMER_BACKEND=triton pytest test_full_model_chain.py: 2 passed in 39.10s at 39053b2

verdicts.change: every run re-measured in wave B; measured_commits is now derived from each run file's own commit field (captured at run start) by the collector, with includes_o7_fix; xrt_reference_golden.json regenerated (from `git archive 615ee61`, commit filled from the archive with commit_note); xrt_reference_hf_bf16.json regenerated at 39053b2 (clean)
xrt_scoring checks and profiling.decode_batch_invariance compare fp32 bit patterns (view(int32))
checks.n_checks / n_skipped / n_tokens_compared; all_byte_equal_to_train = n_checks > 0 and all(...); run_chain --score-file exits 1 when no check ran
verdicts.test: same test as R6 (no check requested / every chunking skipped -> False)

verdicts.change: tiny tests: identities replaced by properties that can fail: every region's exclusive time >= 0 (nesting on the GPU timeline), instrumented total within [0.5x, 5x + 5 ms] of the clean call, every layer's regions charged to its own index; unattributed GPU time <= 10 % and GPU busy <= 1.25 x wall + 0.5 ms (one stream); compare_xrt against a payload with one flipped mantissa bit (n-1 equal, exact |d|)
REPORT STATUS: triton checks W-1/W/W+1 (on the long sequence only), golden W only

REPORT wording: strict global attention ~2x slower than HF's sdpa kernel per layer; GEMM gap > total gap (offset by faster non-GEMM ops); det_gemm share as measured; the paged-cache scatter remark marked as an expectation

logprobs(mode='decode', timings=) and xrt_scoring record prompt_prefill_seconds and decode_step_seconds separately (plus the context of every step); REPORT quotes per-step costs without the prompt prefill

the triton scoring repeat is a second full process at the same commit, committed as xrt_reference_triton_repeat.json; the profiler (gpu) view runs 3 times per config (kernel_profile_repeats); KVPlan._seq_index removed. Decode per-step series: xrt checks decode_step_seconds
